question: Silver articles become black after their exposure to air because they react with___ in the air.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sulphur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• With an** atomic number of 47** and the **chemical symbol Ag,** silver is a** chemical element.**
 
• It is a **smooth, white transition metal** that is** lustrous.**
 
• It is the **metal** with the **highest electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, and reflectivity.**
 
• Silver ultimately **turns black** if it is exposed to** air.**
 
• A **film of silver sulphide**, which is** black in colour**, is created when the** silver metal **combines with the **sulphur in the air.**
 
• **Silver sulfide** is** insoluble** in all **solvents. ​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
